name: Instance stress test
description: GPU-driven culling's measuring scene (p354 Phase 0): a square forest of instanced LOD trees (three mesh levels and a cull), cut into tiles of one pool each, with the camera circling inside it. The count comes from ?stressInstances= (or the scene's debug tab), ?stressPath=gpu draws it as one instance set (the compute cull on WebGPU, the CPU backend on WebGL2), ?stressShadow=true turns on the sun's VSM shadow, ?stressLight=spot or point adds a spot or point light's shadow, ?stressViewport=true a picture-in-picture from above, ?stressMove=0.01 moves 1% of the set's trees each frame, and the tab and the profiler show what the CPU path costs per frame: the pool sync, the LOD selection, the render submit.

debugData.name: Instance stress camera
debugData.description: The main camera: instanceStress.ts circles it inside the forest (or keeps it still), so LOD selection and culling see the same path on every run.
